gloss: not fully convinced; not satisfied; still having doubts

definitions.gloss: not fully convinced; unconvinced; not satisfied; still having doubts
definitions.explanation: A feeling of lingering doubt or dissatisfaction, even after receiving an explanation. Something doesn't quite sit right.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{釈然|しゃくぜん}としない。
examples.english: I'm not fully convinced by his explanation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{謝|あやま}られた→謝る：01177_ayamaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{釈然|しゃくぜん}としない{気持|きも}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: I was apologized to, but a feeling of dissatisfaction lingers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、{釈然|しゃくぜん}としないもの⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Even after hearing the reasons for the verdict, something doesn't sit right.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always used in the negative form としない. The positive form {釈然|しゃくぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be fully convinced) exists but is rare. Expresses an intellectual or emotional unease that persists despite apparent resolution.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {釈然|しゃくぜん}としない⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧ (a feeling of being unconvinced)
- {釈然|しゃくぜん}としない⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧ (an unconvincing point)
- ⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{釈然|しゃくぜん}としない (something just doesn't add up)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {腑|ふ}に{落|お}ちない: to not make sense, to be unconvincing — similar but focuses on logic
- ⟦{納得|なっとく}できない→納得する：26805_nattokusuru⟧: cannot accept/agree — more straightforward disagreement
